newsitem.title: USA: Abbott Q1 U.S., international sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Abbott Q1 U.S., international sales rise.

text.p: Abbott Laboratories Inc said Wednesday its total U.S. sales rose 14.6 percent for the first quarter of 1997 versus 1996, and international sales were up 8.7 percent.
Total sales in U.S. markets were $1.851 billion, compared with $1.616 billion last year. Total international sales were $1.149 billion, up from $1.056 billion reported a year ago.
Earlier, Abbott reported first quarter earnings of $0.69 a share versus $0.61 a share last year. Revenues rose to $3.0 billion from $2.7 billion in 1996.
Abbott said its worldwide sales of pharmaceutical and nutritional products were $1.826 billion in the first quarter, a 14.2 percent increase from $1.600 billion last year.
U.S. sales of pharmaceutical and nutritional products accounted for $1.199 billion of this total, and international sales, including direct exports from the United States, accounted for $627 million.

Worldwide sales of hospital and laboratory products totaled $1.174 billion in the first quarter, a 9.4 percent increase from the same period in 1996. U.S. sales of hospital and laboratory products accounted for $652 million of this total, and international sales for $522 million.
Abbott said its research and development expenses rose to $280 million, up 4.3 percent versus first quarter in 1996.
